# Keepdate

> Keepdate reminds you before your passport expires, your car is due for inspection or a contract renews. Ready-made templates, no account, no ads.

Keepdate is a mobile app (Android, iOS) that reminds people of recurring and expiring deadlines:
vehicle inspections, motorhome gas checks, smoke detectors, passports, notice periods and more.
It has no account, no ads and no tracking; all data stays on the device.
Pricing: 5 deadlines free, then EUR 2.99 per year or EUR 9.99 once.
Guides on this site state their sources and the date they were checked.
